text:
sam: Quick sync — postmortem follow-up on yesterday's autoscale bump. We need owners for the three action items: quota backstop, scheduler tune, and headroom dashboard.

maria: I can take quota backstop. Plan is to add a hard limit + alerting window. ETA EOD Fri.

kai: I'll pick up scheduler tuning. Need to validate backpressure thresholds and the bin-packing heuristics. Will run a quick sim first.

sam: thanks. lucy, can you take headroom dashboard and add a rolling 24h headroom metric + predicted runway?

lucy: yep. I'll wire it into the infra metrics and add a small table to the ops console. target: next Wed.

maria: for quota backstop, proposal: add a soft throttle at 85% reserved + notify paging on 90% for 10m. If sustained >95% trigger pre-emptive scale (if available) or failover. Thoughts?

kai: soft throttle makes sense. For scheduler we should also adjust the eviction priority for background batches so interactive requests keep low tail-latency. I'll test with config: `evict_score = cpu_frac * 1.2 + mem_frac * 0.8` and a max_batch_wait_ms = 25.

sam: @kai add that config as a patch to the test cluster and post results. Add perf numbers (p50/p95/p99) and any regressed throughput.

kai: will do. running sim now against last 7 days of arrival traces. posting results in thread when done.

devops-bot: Reminder: incident template created: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1742003456

lucy: question — how do we define "predicted runway"? simple linear extrapolation of current consumption vs. capacity, or use our short-term time-series model?

sam: short-term model is better (uses seasonality). But start with linear for the dashboard and flag model output as a separate column.

maria: FYI — I'll add an acceptance test: simulate a scheduled spike and verify backstop engages and notifies on-call. Add snippet:

```
# test harness
start_spike(duration=600s, qps=3x)
expect(alert='quota_backstop', within=60s)
```

sam: ownership recap: maria -> quota backstop (EOD Fri), kai -> scheduler tuning + sim (share numbers in 24h), lucy -> headroom dashboard (Weds). I'll follow up in next standup. Any blockers?

kai: one potential blocker: we may need a tiny infra change to expose per-pool mem_frac in the scheduler. I'll open a quick PR.

lucy: dependency note: the ops console change needs a minor API add from eng-platform. pinging @eng-platform in a sec.

sam: thanks. if anything slips, escalate here. Also label these action items in the postmortem doc under "follow-ups" so CS and SRE can track.

maria: added tasks to the remediation board: https://redwood.internal/boards/remediation/17420

devops-bot: Action items assigned: #A-102 (quota backstop), #A-103 (scheduler tuning), #A-104 (headroom dashboard). Due dates: 2024-07-12, 2024-07-14, 2024-07-17 respectively.

sam: perfect. I'll close the loop after we've validated the scheduler sim. Thanks team :thumbsup:
